claims.statement: Current evidence covers campaign control, configured two-wave P1 execution, readiness, and portable provider-free supervisor recovery; broad and Windows host claims remain open.

population.partitionRule: Fixtures partition contracts, findings, waves, ownership, recovery, portable supervision, validation, reports, budgets, and closure.
population.residualSpace: Other repositories/providers, long-duration or reboot behavior, Windows host registration, non-Windows hosts, extra playbooks, and protected or remote effects.

materialExclusions: Universal defect discovery or semantic correctness for every project
Concurrent source writers or concurrent campaigns in one worktree
Remote mutation, deployment, release, credentials, or destructive external effects
Autonomous resolution of protected product, security, privacy, authorization, legal, or policy decisions
unknowns: Windows registration/re-entry, critical SDET, and broad-claim challenge remain open.
claims.maximumSupportedClaim: Provider-free evidence covers restart-safe campaign control, mission and terminal handoffs, readiness, portable supervisor recovery, and replay. One configured nine-root campaign completed two P1 waves with checkpoints, re-review, validation, proof, final challenge, and cleanup. Population closure, Windows host supervision, deployment, release, and remote effects are unsupported.
